title: androsace stenophylla
intro: Androsace stenophylla, commonly known as Himalayan snow lotus or Tibetan snow lotus, is a perennial plant native to the high-altitude mountain ranges of the Himalayas. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Androsace stenophylla are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
